segments.text: Every planet, to the second. In one file that never goes online.
This is Astro-Amriit, the Karar Ashram astrology software.
Type a birth chart, and it casts the way Parashara's Light 9 does: nine planets out of nine, equal to the second.
Vargas, dashas, Jaimini, transits and matching. And research tabs that bring Iyer's NTP, and Krishnamurti's six KP Readers, to your chart, with the book and page for every rule.
No installation. No internet. Nothing leaves your computer.
Astro-Amriit. Cast once. Read every page.
